info.title: Quotes
info.x-hubspot-api-use-case: Create a contract proposal for a customer who is interested in signing up for one of your annual SEO auditing service packages.
info.x-hubspot-introduction: Use the quotes API to create and manage sales quotes for sharing pricing information with potential buyers.

get.description: Read a page of quotes. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Create a quote with the given properties and return a copy of the object, including the ID. Documentation and examples for creating standard quotes is provided.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.summary: Archive a batch of quotes by ID
post.description: Archive multiple quotes by their IDs in a single request, effectively moving them to the recycling bin.
Create multiple quotes in a single request by providing a batch of quote objects, each with its own properties and optional associations.

post.summary: Read a batch of quotes by internal ID, or unique property values
post.description: Retrieve records by record ID or include the `idProperty` parameter to retrieve records by a custom unique value property.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

post.summary: Update a batch of quotes by internal ID, or unique property values
post.description: Update multiple quotes using their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint allows batch processing of quote updates, ensuring efficient management of multiple records in a single request.

post.summary: Create or update a batch of quotes by unique property values
post.description: Create or update records identified by a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object.

Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. This endpoint allows you to specify an optional 'idProperty' set to 'email' to identify the contact by email address. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist to prevent future use.

Merge two CRM objects of the same type in your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties and associations of the specified objects into a single object. Use this endpoint to streamline duplicate records and maintain data integrity.

post.summary: Search for quotes using specified criteria.
post.description: Execute a search for quotes based on the criteria defined in the request body, such as filters, properties, and sorting options. This endpoint allows for detailed querying of quote records to retrieve specific data sets.

get.description: Read an Object identified by `{quoteId}`. `{quoteId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param.  Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

delete.description: Move an Object identified by `{quoteId}` to the recycling bin.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{quoteId}`or optionally a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `{quoteId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, and the `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will result in an error. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

get.description: List all associations of an object by object type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations for a specified object, with a limit of 500 results per call. It is useful for understanding the relationships between different objects in your CRM.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.
